groups.name: Infantry and terrain movement
groups.application: Human, skeleton and beast infantry surface/weight references.
groups.caveat: Recorded foley, not species-specific paw movement.

groups.name: Blades, polearms, blunt weapons and armor
groups.application: Swords, knives, axes, scythes, spear/halberd/lance/trident, mace/hammer/staff and shields.
groups.caveat: Material candidates; fictional weapon variants require audition.

groups.name: Bows and projectiles
groups.application: Bows, crossbows, bone bows, harpoons, thorns and stones.
groups.caveat: Actual bow/crossbow recordings; harpoons, thorns and stones use texture candidates.

groups.name: Magic casting and impacts
groups.application: Spark, light, spectral orb, gravebolt, boneburst, soul drain, root crush and tide magic.
groups.caveat: Designed effects; role suggestions rather than final assignments.

groups.name: Fire
groups.application: Fireslinger firepot layers and sustained flame.
groups.caveat: Fire spell is designed; fireplace source does not specify recording method.

groups.name: Undead and ghosts
groups.application: Ghost, spectre, wraith, lich, necromancer and skeleton casters.
groups.caveat: Performed human voices and upstream Audacity synthesis.

groups.name: Animal movement and attacks
groups.application: Mounted humans/grave riders; wolf fangs, boar trample/tusks, bear claws, giant bat bite.
groups.caveat: Trot is jacket/water-bottle foley. Soft impacts and mouth performances are designed action candidates, not authentic recordings of paws, bites or claws.

groups.name: Natural canine and equine vocals
groups.application: Horse cavalry and canine reference for wolf/direwolf/werewolf.
groups.caveat: Domestic dog at play is not a wolf recording. Neigh/snort are outdoor horse recordings.

groups.name: Fantasy animal vocals
groups.application: Boar, bear, bat, wolf and transformed creatures: designed references.
groups.caveat: Processed mouth performances, not authentic species recordings.

limitations: Natural species recordings provided only for domestic dog and horse. No authentic wolf, boar, bear, fox or bat recording is claimed.
No final per-unit sound design, trimming, gain matching or game/soundboard integration is included. All originals remain unmodified.
Current game synthesis remains in dist/audio/current and is excluded from this CC0 collection.
